Author: Coasted-create
Name: Sculpt+
Punchline: Shape your character by dragging dots on it. Works on top of Customize+.
Description: Dots appear on your character: drag one to move that part, scroll to resize it, right-drag to turn it. Sliders in plain words (fuller lips, wider hips), dice with an Evolve mode, presets, a soft brush, before/after, kept shapes with pictures that stay on through logins, sharing as text, and export as a Customize+ template. Everything shows live through a temporary Customize+ profile; your Customize+ data is not changed. Requires Customize+. Command: /sculpt
